text: ぼくの　とり　ポケモン　そろそろ…　たたかわせて　みようか！

structure.jp: ぼくの　とり　ポケモン
たたかわせて　みようか！
structure.en: shall I try making them battle!

patterns.name: 〜てみる
patterns.span: たたかわせて　みようか
patterns.explanation: The て form plus みる means to try doing something and see how it goes. たたかわせて みようか = 'shall I try having them battle?'.

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: The せる ending on a verb means making or letting someone do it. たたかわせて = 'making them battle'.

patterns.name: 〜ようか
patterns.explanation: The よう ending means 'let's' or 'I think I will', and か makes it a musing 'shall I?'. みようか = 'shall I give it a try?'.
